tips.text: Pick the normal Hyena Pack assassination when a Phorid invasion is up; the invasion version drops Nyx parts.
Run the Hyena Pack solo; you face only two randomly chosen Hyenas.
Kill one Hyena at a time instead of shooting whichever is closest.
Bring an energy restore for Hyena TH, whose aura drains your energy.
Queue all three components at once so you wait 12 hours, not 36.
Players rank Loki among the easiest non-Prime frames; Systems is the slowest part to drop.
